items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Now, Mr. Supper always paid me my money.

ctx.x: Now, Mr. Supper always paid me my money. When he'd promise me, if it was $10.00, he gave me $10.00. Whatever he promised me, he gave to me, and I remember once Mr. Supper, if I'm not mistaken, gave me $368.00 in one check, if I'm not mistaken.

But in the meantime Mayo Williams had gotten with Mr. -- not with Mr. Supper -- but I think he had gone to Mills and them -- Mills Music -- and I don't know what he did, but I think he maneuvered a little bit and got some of my money. See?
